Welltower Inc. is an American real estate investment trust that invests in healthcare facilities such as retirement and nursing homes, and outpatient medical clinics. As of December 31, 2022, the company had investments in approximately 3,000 properties, all of which were in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom.
Welltower is ranked 534th on the Fortune 500 in 2025. In 2011, the company acquired most real estate assets of Genesis HealthCare for $2.4 billion, adding 147 properties, including post-acute, skilled nursing, and assisted living facilities, in 11 states.
One property each is located in British Columbia, Saskatchewan, and Newfoundland. In early 2015, the company purchased all of Aspen Healthcare's four London hospitals for £226 million, including Holly House Hospital, Highgate Hospital, and Parkside Hospital and Cancer Centre, which were then leased back to Aspen for a 25-year terms. In August 2015, Welltower formed a joint venture with the Canada Pension Plan Investment Board (CPPIB) to acquire a combined interest of 50.5 percent in a portfolio of medical office buildings in Southern California from healthcare REIT G&L Realty.
In April 2018, Welltower and ProMedica acquired Healthpeak Properties spin-off Quality Care Properties, along with HCR ManorCare, for $4.4 billion. In 2025, Welltower acquired Amica Senior Lifestyles from the Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan, for US$4.6 billion and, that June, it acquired NorthStar Healthcare Income REIT for $US900 million in cash.
According to researchers at Corporate Watch, Welltower’s acquisition of the UK’s largest care home providers HC-One and Barchester Healthcare in late 2025 made Welltower the largest single investor in the UK care home industry.

you.snippet:
Welltower Inc. is an American real estate investment trust that invests in healthcare facilities such as retirement and nursing homes, and outpatient medical clinics. As of December 31, 2022, the company had investments in approximately 3,000 properties, all of which were in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom.
Welltower is ranked 534th on the Fortune 500 in 2025. In 2011, the company acquired most real estate assets of Genesis HealthCare for $2.4 billion, adding 147 properties, including post-acute, skilled nursing, and assisted living facilities, in 11 states.
One property each is located in British Columbia, Saskatchewan, and Newfoundland. In early 2015, the company purchased all of Aspen Healthcare's four London hospitals for £226 million, including Holly House Hospital, Highgate Hospital, and Parkside Hospital and Cancer Centre, which were then leased back to Aspen for a 25-year terms. In August 2015, Welltower formed a joint venture with the Canada Pension Plan Investment Board (CPPIB) to acquire a combined interest of 50.5 percent in a portfolio of medical office buildings in Southern California from healthcare REIT G&L Realty.
In April 2018, Welltower and ProMedica acquired Healthpeak Properties spin-off Quality Care Properties, along with HCR ManorCare, for $4.4 billion. In 2025, Welltower acquired Amica Senior Lifestyles from the Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan, for US$4.6 billion and, that June, it acquired NorthStar Healthcare Income REIT for $US900 million in cash.
According to researchers at Corporate Watch, Welltower’s acquisition of the UK’s largest care home providers HC-One and Barchester Healthcare in late 2025 made Welltower the largest single investor in the UK care home industry.
